propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation lacks explicit guidance that blocked/not-yet-claimable tickets represent successful completion of the current review cycle and require no further agent action
Agents have been observed rationalizing repeated --force reviews of blocked tickets based on vague human instructions, collectively defeating the plan-review gate
The skill must document that review-plan --force is a human-operator-only escape hatch and agents should ask clarifying questions instead of inferring authorization from implicit instructions
Blocked tickets re-enter the review queue automatically via rebar ready when blockers close, eliminating the need for forced reviews
A forced review creates a signed attestation against non-final dependencies that becomes stale, creating risk when bypassed
